functions.name: get_keys_from_context
functions.description: Resolve a data frame of taxon names to GBIF usage keys by supplying the full taxonomic hierarchy (kingdom..species) as disambiguation context, preventing homonym errors (e.g. Alaria the alga vs. the trematode)

inputs.name: hierarchy_df
inputs.description: One row per taxon, columns named for Linnaean ranks (case-insensitive: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species). Not all ranks required; the most specific non-empty rank per row is the lookup target, higher ranks are disambiguation context.

output.description: Input data frame with usageKey (GBIF taxon key, NA if unmatched), matchType (EXACT/FUZZY/HIGHERRANK/LOOKUP_RECOVERED/NONE/NO_DATA/ERROR), and gbif_rank columns appended

functions.scaling_note: GBIF API; fast for small lists

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Max records per key

output.description: Occurrence records with coordinates, dates, taxonomy, bibliographicCitation

functions.scaling_note: GBIF API; ~1-10 min depending on number of keys and records

functions.name: filter_gbif_quality
functions.description: Filter GBIF records by coordinate quality, basis of record, GBIF issue codes, and (if CoordinateCleaner installed) equal-coordinate/near-zero/near-GBIF-HQ/near-country-centroid/near-capital checks. Institution proximity is FLAGGED (flag_institution=TRUE default), never auto-removed

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: GBIF occurrence data frame

inputs.name: max_coord_uncertainty
inputs.description: Max coordinate uncertainty in meters

inputs.name: exclude_absent
inputs.description: Remove occurrenceStatus = 'ABSENT' rows (systematic-survey non-detections)

inputs.name: require_species
inputs.description: Set TRUE when querying by family/genus key, to drop genus-only rows lacking a species value

inputs.name: flag_institution
inputs.description: 2026-07-23 rename from exclude_institution: proximity to a biodiversity institution is now FLAGGED (institution_flag/institution_name/institution_type/institution_dist_m columns added, row retained), never removed -- field stations/marine labs are often sited exactly where good habitat is

output.description: Filtered occurrences (institution-flagged rows retained with 4 new columns). attr(result, 'removed_records') is always present (2026-07-23) -- a data frame, possibly zero rows, of every removed record plus a filter_reason column explaining why

functions.scaling_note: Fast; row filtering. ~1.4s at 122k rows with all CoordinateCleaner checks on

functions.name: stack_occurrences
functions.description: Row-bind occurrence data frames from multiple sources; attach report_params with citations. 2026-07-23: NO LONGER deduplicates -- row count is always exactly the sum of the inputs. Always follow with dedupe_occurrences(), even for a single source

inputs.description: One or more occurrence data frames

inputs.name: lat_col
inputs.description: Latitude column name

inputs.name: lon_col
inputs.description: Longitude column name

output.description: Combined occurrence data frame with citations attribute. Never removes rows -- call dedupe_occurrences() next

functions.name: dedupe_occurrences
functions.description: 2026-07-23, new -- split out of stack_occurrences(). Removes duplicates from a single occurrence data frame (stacked or not) via (1) exact gbifID match and (2) collapse_duplicate_occasions, a content-based match on taxon x date x rounded lat/lon that catches repeat citizen-science reports of one detection occasion across DIFFERENT records/platforms (e.g. many eBird checklists for one rare-bird alert). Call this even after a single-source fetch -- one GBIF call querying overlapping taxon keys can already contain duplicates

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: A single occurrence data frame (output of stack_occurrences() or a direct fetch)

inputs.name: collapse_duplicate_occasions
inputs.description: Content-based occasion collapse (taxon x date x rounded lat/lon). Default TRUE because TaxaExpect::estimate_kernel_priors() counts raw records as both a species' effective share and the site's effective sample size -- uncollapsed repeat reports inflate a species' modeled detection frequency directly

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon column for the content-based match

inputs.name: date_col
inputs.description: Date column; falls back to year/month/day when absent

inputs.name: lat_col
inputs.description: Latitude column

inputs.name: lon_col
inputs.description: Longitude column

inputs.name: coord_precision
inputs.description: Decimal places to round lat/lon to before matching

output.description: Deduplicated occurrence data frame. A row missing any key component is always kept (never dropped on incomplete data)

functions.name: check_geographic_outliers
functions.description: For species with few LOCAL (bbox-scoped) records, fetches that species' GLOBAL GBIF distribution and flags local records that are geographic outliers against it (e.g. one mis-georeferenced citizen-science record from the wrong continent). Well-supported local species are skipped -- the global fetch is the expensive step. Requires the CoordinateCleaner package

inputs.name: local_occurrences
inputs.description: Bbox-scoped occurrence data, typically post filter_gbif_quality()/dedupe_occurrences()

inputs.name: min_local_n
inputs.description: Species with fewer than this many local records are checked against their global distribution

inputs.name: min_occs
inputs.description: Minimum global record count required to run the outlier test at all

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: CoordinateCleaner::cc_outl() method

inputs.name: tdi
inputs.description: Distance threshold in km for the outlier test

inputs.name: year_range
inputs.description: Year range for the global GBIF fetch, e.g. '2000,2024'. Default (NULL) resolves dynamically at call time to "2000,<current year>" (.gbif_default_year_range()) -- 2026-09-07 metadata resync: previously a stale fixed literal '2000,2024' that silently excluded 2025+ GBIF data (fixed in TaxaFetch 2026-08-08).

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Directory for resumable global-fetch cache

output.description: Input with local_n, global_n_unique, outlier_status columns added. outlier_status is always one of 'not_tested_sufficient_local_data' / 'insufficient_global_data' / 'outlier' / 'consistent' -- never a bare logical. Rows are NOT removed automatically; filter outlier_status != 'outlier' explicitly

functions.scaling_note: GBIF API; only species below min_local_n trigger an extra global fetch
